title: SMM - Ultra Light Weight Shader
description: Lightweight shader designed for low-end hardware.
body:
# What's Inside In This Shader

### This shader focuses on subtle lighting improvements, soft color correction, and a clean atmosphere while keeping performance impact extremely low.

###    Features:
### - Very low FPS impact
### - Subtle color enhancement
### - Lightweight post-processing
### - No heavy shadows
### - Designed for older and low-end GPUs

## Perfect for players who want a cleaner and more immersive look without sacrificing performance.

### Compatible with OptiFine and Iris Shader Loader.

### Various versions have been tested, but we recommend version 1.16.5 or higher for the most stable experience.
